mentions.name: Pagecord
mentions.description: A hosted personal website and blogging platform made in Edinburgh, offering all the features you could want and released as open source. The author invites people to try it while working through an acquisition funnel problem.
mentions.problem: The builder has an acquisition funnel problem and is asking people to kick the tyres.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Pagecord! The best personal website and blogging platform made in Edinburgh you’ll ever use!

All the features you could want. Open source.

Please kick the tyres, I have an acquisition funnel problem! :)

https://pagecord.com
